source.title: Laurie Keats dies at 92 after lifetime devoted to Golden Shears

en.summary: Laurie Keats, the man who founded New Zealand's Golden Shears shearing contest, passed away at 92, leaving a legacy in the niche sport.
en.why_irrelevant: It is a niche rural sport story, far from mainstream global affairs.

zh.why_irrelevant: 这是小众乡村运动新闻，远离主流全球话题。
